Add generation of notification service models (#2566)

* Add generation of notification service models

* Move the notification models to common so they can be used from handlers and the client.

* add changelog entry

* fix(nexus): honor configured notification failure converters

Carry synchronous payload and failure converters through System Nexus conversion. Exercise TypeInfo encoding and hint forwarding in notification round-trip tests.

* test(nexus): make notification codec cases explicit

Split codec and non-codec test declarations and remove the re-export identity test.

* fix(nexus): adapt notification converters to nexgen 0.2.11

* build(nexus): regenerate notification model documentation

* Update changelog
